title: Appeals and Grievances Clause Sheet: Payment on Inpatient Days Carried to a Second-Level Reconsideration
content:
Appeals and Grievances clause sheet — payment for the days carried

Scope: a second-level reconsideration asked for on a decided Medical Necessity Reconsideration of an inpatient mental health authorization.

**Clause.** The payment the days carried would carry is figured by one of three methods: where the other insurer's payment counted is at least the allowed amount, no payment would be made; where a payment by another insurer below the allowed amount is counted, the cost share is figured on the allowed amount less that payment and the payment is that net amount less the cost share, rounded to the cent; in every other case the cost share is figured on the allowed amount itself and the payment is the allowed amount less the cost share, rounded to the cent.

For the days carried, the allowed amount is the daily allowed amount multiplied by the number of days, rounded to the cent, and the other insurer's payment counted is the other insurer's daily payment multiplied by the number of days, rounded to the cent. The tier whose figures apply is the TRICARE Select tier of the enrollment the stay's paid day lines were billed under.

Hypothetical: 4 days at a daily allowed amount of 750.00 (allowed amount 3,000.00); a daily-charge cost share of 250.00 for each day (1,000.00).

| Other insurer's daily payment | Payment counted for the 4 days | Figured on | Payment |
|---|---|---|---|
| 800.00 | 3,200.00 | — | none (at least the allowed amount) |
| 50.00 | 200.00 | 2,800.00 | 2,800.00 less 1,000.00, which is 1,800.00 |
| zero | none | 3,000.00 | 3,000.00 less 1,000.00, which is 2,000.00 |
